title: Single-shot: CSV to JSON CLI
taskPrompt: Write a Node.js script named convert.js in the current directory. It reads a CSV file path from process.argv[2], parses it (the first line is the header row, comma-separated, no quoted fields or embedded commas), and prints the resulting array of objects as JSON to stdout via console.log(JSON.stringify(...)) — one JSON array, nothing else printed. Example: a file containing "name,age\nAlice,30\nBob,25" should print exactly [{"name":"Alice","age":"30"},{"name":"Bob","age":"25"}]. When you believe it works, actually run it with a sample CSV file you create yourself and confirm the output before calling finish.
